lines.text: David sings that praise awaits God in Zion, and all people will come to the One who listens to prayer.
When iniquities prevail, God atones for transgressions, and the one He chooses to dwell in His courts is tested.
God is the hope of the ends of the earth, and He formed the mountains and stilled the seas.
God waters the earth, prepares the grain, soaks the furrows, and softens the ground with hail.
God crowns the year with bounty, the hills are robed with joy, and the valleys are decked with grain.
